services.name: 2.5 Hour Harbor Cruise
services.desc: Welcome Aboard! Schedule Wednesday - Sunday 11am, 2:30pm and 6pm CHECK IN: 30 minutes prior to departure Duration: 2.5 Hours This ticketed cruise will take you through San Diego Bay to splash by all the major monuments including the USS Midway and under the Coronado Bridge! Our captain and crew will guide your adventure throughout San Diego Bay for fresh air, great music, delicious drinks, and gorgeous views. Cruise Features Coast Guard certified captain and crew members Spacious open seating floor plan Full 13-seat bar to purchase a variety of alcoholic and non alcoholic beverages Dance floor with a variety of music playing 2 upscale bathrooms Multiple bean bags for lounging on the bow
